entities.summary: Peter Fatomilola (b. 1946-01-16, Ekiti State) was a journalist or media commentator of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Ekiti State and Nigeria. Known in the fields of nigeria, poets & playwrights, africa.
